entities.name: Cyrus the Great
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Founder of the Achaemenid Persian Empire (c. 600–530 BCE), the largest empire the ancient world had ever seen. He conquered the Median, Lydian, and Neo-Babylonian empires. His Cyrus Cylinder — often called the first declaration of human rights — proclaimed religious tolerance and the freeing of slaves, earning admiration from Jews, Greeks, and historians alike.
